title: Turn rough notes into a short checklist
body: Turn the supplied rough notes into a short checklist. Keep every named person, time, and condition. Do not add facts. Clearly mark missing information.

title: Rewrite a message to sound clear and friendly
body: Rewrite the supplied message to sound clear and friendly. Preserve its meaning and supplied details. Do not add promises or facts.

title: Compare options in a table
body: Compare the supplied options in a table using only the information provided. Mark missing information rather than guessing.
